title: Final step of the guide-copying scan
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a finite schedule-alphabet word. For any base configuration on $x$, integers $b,u$, and budget and unary tapes, if the machine is in the copy phase corresponding to $|x|$ copied symbols, with input head at position $|x|+1$, guide head at cell $|x|$, and guide tape equal to the partial guide with $|x|$ copied cells, one step takes it to copy-return phase with the same input-head position and guide-head coordinate and guide tape equal to the partial guide with $|x|+1$ copied cells; the base data, budget tape and head, and unary tape and head are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: schedule input x and base configuration
replaced:
From a setup configuration in the copy phase for $|x|$ copied symbols, with input head
parked at the right boundary $|x|+1$ (reading blank) and guide head at $|x|$, a single
step enters the copy-return phase, leaves both heads in place, and closes the copied
zone by writing one more mark, producing the partial guide with $|x|+1$ cells.
